description: Find home-service and trade businesses enrolled in Book It that serve a US ZIP code for a trade, such as HVAC, plumbing, roofing or lawn care. Returns each business's name, phone, website, the services that match the stated need, and its next open request window. Only businesses that enrolled and list that ZIP in their own service area appear; the result states the ordering rule, which is a fair daily rotation and never paid placement. An empty list means no enrolled business covers that trade and ZIP yet.

need.description: What the person needs in a few words, such as "furnace blowing cold air". Used to surface matching services.

trade.description: The trade or a common name for it: "hvac", "furnace repair", "plumber", "roofer", "lawn care", "tree service".

zip.description: The 5-digit US ZIP code where the work is.

name: find_provider
title: Find a local provider
